# Tuning the T8

## Tuning with TxSuite

TxSuite's Tuning menu gives you direct access to the most important maps, grouped by airmass, torque, injectors, fuel, boost, ignition and pedal.
An entry only shows when the binary has the map.

Tuning → Tuning Wizard applies a pre-defined set of Tuning Actions to your binary, the `.t8x` packs that come with TxSuite.
It only offers the packs that fit your software and makes a backup of the binary first.

Actions → Airmass result viewer shows what a tune ends up with: the airmass per combustion for each pedal position and rpm, and which limiter holds it back.

How to use all of this is in the TxSuite user manual, Help → T8 → User manual.
